question: Do same-lineage direct 0-to-2 essential-birth collision masses follow the conditional area law D_N=A N^(-5/6) across four exact doubling generations?

lineage.geometry: the exact 1+i Gaussian-child sequence already used by P337
lineage.within_size_coupling: first and second share the same counter-keyed permutation and are one paired covariance block

estimator.event: kind=DIRECT_RANK2, equivalently K1=K2 with no projective line
estimator.delete_one: delete one common batch index from both orientations within a size
estimator.covariance: retain the 2x2 first/second jackknife covariance within every size; cross-size covariance is zero by independent RNG domains

fixed_primary.form: log Dbar_N = log A - (5/6) log N
fixed_primary.origin: conditional six-arm adversary frozen at 652bf15; not selected from these four values

free_power_diagnostic.form: log Dbar_N = log A - beta log N
free_power_diagnostic.role: estimate the effective exponent without replacing the fixed primary target

minimal_curvature_diagnostic.form: log Dbar_N = a - beta log N + kappa*(log2(N/85)-1.5)^2
minimal_curvature_diagnostic.role: one additional log-curvature coordinate; post-fit diagnostic, not a new scaling claim

secondary_scores.doubling: jointly score the three adjacent log ratios against -(5/6)log 2 with their shared-size covariance
secondary_scores.heldout: fit only the fixed-exponent amplitude on N85/N170/N340, then score N680 using source-amplitude plus N680 variance
secondary_scores.external_lineage: report N325/N425 Dbar from 2e99533 as an external-lineage comparison only; do not include it in the same-lineage fit or evidence count

decision_rule: The fixed 5/6 line survives only if the four-size GLS goodness-of-fit p is at least 0.01. Report free beta and curvature regardless. Do not select a model by largest p and do not call compatibility an arm correspondence proof.
claim_boundary: The 5/6 exponent is a conditional six-arm scaling line, not an exact arm-event correspondence or universality theorem.
First and second orientations are paired views of one random block at each size, not independent evidence.
N325/N425 use a different geometry lineage and are external controls only.
No new Monte Carlo is authorized.
